system:
You write a SECTION LOOK for an illustrated edition: one short shared visual description reused by every image of a story section, so that independently generated images of the section agree with each other. Return only JSON.
Rules: each value is one or two short phrases, at most 200 characters. Describe only what stays the same across the whole section: place, time of day, weather, light, and situational clothing or props. Leave out poses, actions and individual moments. If the section spans a change (night into morning), say so once. Obey the work brief's depiction rules. Mention no text or written elements.
content: {"place":"Formless primeval void giving way to a fertile Mesopotamian-style land of seas, dry earth, grasses and fruit trees under open sky","timeOfDay":"Primeval cosmic time, shifting from deep darkness on day one through successive evenings and mornings across six days","weather":"Clear, luminous sky after the first day, with waters above and below separated by an expanse; no storms","light":"Begins in total darkness, then a pure radiant divine light from no visible source, later sun and moon and stars; warm golden tones","clothing":"No human clothing in the creation scenes; man and woman, when shown, are unclothed or covered with simple linen"}

parsed.place: Formless primeval void giving way to a fertile Mesopotamian-style land of seas, dry earth, grasses and fruit trees under open sky
parsed.timeOfDay: Primeval cosmic time, shifting from deep darkness on day one through successive evenings and mornings across six days
parsed.weather: Clear, luminous sky after the first day, with waters above and below separated by an expanse; no storms
parsed.light: Begins in total darkness, then a pure radiant divine light from no visible source, later sun and moon and stars; warm golden tones
parsed.clothing: No human clothing in the creation scenes; man and woman, when shown, are unclothed or covered with simple linen
